text:
maya: heads up — promo to prod is blocked, deploy-bot failed on the canary promote step with an artifact/cache read error. staging smoke failing 1/3 integration suites.

deploy-bot: Promotion failed: artifact fetch error from registry: HTTP 200 but truncated body (expected 1048576, got 524288). Unable to stream blob to runtime.

liam: which job id? staging-e2e-2026-03? can you paste excerpt from logs?

maya: job staging-e2e-7242 (canary). logs:
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:31Z] GET /v2/artifacts/blobs/sha256:3a7f2b -> 200 OK
[2026-03-21T14:02:31Z] Content-Length: 1048576
[2026-03-21T14:02:31Z] read: unexpected EOF after 524288 bytes
[2026-03-21T14:02:32Z] error: blob truncated / io.ErrUnexpectedEOF

Integration suite: failed while unpacking image layer, exit 1
```

nina: looks like a partial upload / registry replication issue. We have two options: 1) pin the canary route back to last_good sha (fast) or 2) reupload artifact from CI and re-run promote (longer, but keeps the new build).

sam: reupload requires re-running the publish step and waiting for registry replication across mirrors — estimate ~10-20m. Then canary smoke another ~10m. Pin would be ~5m (PR + promote). Change window ends in ~25m.

liam: tradeoffs: pin is the safest to avoid missing the window. What was in the new build? any critical bugfix?

nina: new build only had a logging fix and a small metrics opt. Not customer-facing. I'm leaning pin.

maya: agreed. I'll open a quick pin PR to set canary image to last_good sha `sha256:3a7f2b9d` and include rollback notes. After merge, deploy-bot can re-run manual promote.

maya: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/deploy-config/pulls/432 — description: "Pin canary to previous artifact due to truncated blob during promotion. Follow-up: re-publish artifact and re-promote after window." :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Created incident task IR-7242: registry partial upload detected. Notifying infra team and creating ticket #IRS-7242.

sam: I'll kick off a re-publish job once the pin is merged, keep logs open and watch replication. If deploy-bot still erroring after pin, we'll rollback everything. :eyes:

liam: also add to release notes: "Canary promotion pinned to previous artifact due to partial artifact upload; follow-up re-publish planned — will include logging fix in next push."

nina: leaving a note on the changelog and release notes draft.

maya: merge done, deploy-bot triggered manual promote after PR merge. Monitoring: canary smoke started.

deploy-bot: Manual promote initiated by maya. Canary route updated to sha256:3a7f2b9d. Smoke suites running (0/3).

sam: re-publish job in progress (CI job #7242-republish). Will post link when done.

liam: thanks everyone — decision: pin for release window, follow-up re-publish and re-promote outside window. Documenting in release notes and rollback ticket. :thumbsup:
